dashboard.title: Finance Dashboard
dashboard.hubDescription: Oversee all financial operations, including fee management, expenses, payroll links, and reporting.
dashboard.enhancementNote: Dashboard enhanced with key stats, charts, and quick links.

banks.title: Bank Accounts Management
banks.description: Manage the school's bank accounts. Each bank account must be linked to an Asset account in the Chart of Accounts.
banks.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this bank account?

chartOfAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts Management
chartOfAccounts.description: Manage the school's chart of accounts. Define accounts for assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, and expenses.
chartOfAccounts.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this account? This might affect linked bank accounts or fee templates.
chartOfAccounts.alertRequiredFields: Account Code, Name, Type, and Template Type are required.
